messages:
Sam Kim: Quick idea: draft for attenuated rollouts for runtime config. Goal: reduce activation delta on high-traffic routes and bump telemetry sampling before larger exposure.
Priya Patel: Nice. How does the attenuation decision work? paste the sketch.
Sam Kim: Algorithm sketch: score = qps * max(0, error_rate_change). cap_delta = base_delta / (1 + score * k). base_delta=0.05 by default. Use EMA for error_rate_change.
Luis: Error-rate-change is noisy; require a 5m EMA and min-sample 1k requests. Also floor the cap_delta to 0.5*base_delta for safety.
Sam Kim: Good call. Will add floor and EMA.
Nora: Console UX: add an "attenuated" badge with tooltip showing reason and factor. Provide manual override and an "auto-rollback" toggle per-flag.
Priya Patel: Telemetry gating: only advance to next step when metric delta < threshold for Y minutes. Default metrics = [p95_latency, error_rate_5xx]. If p95 missing, fallback to p50.
Sam Kim: Proposed runtime contract: GET /config?target=route returns {variant, exposure, attenuation} where attenuation is {active:true/false, factor:0.8, reason:"high-latency"}. Apps can use it to increase logging. (Naming bikeshed welcome.)
Luis: Important: quotas should reflect actual routed traffic not intended exposure. If attenuation reduces routed requests, quota consumption must match. Console should show expected vs actual exposure.
Priya Patel: Also increase telemetry sampling for attenuated requests (+x10) to improve signal. Add e2e test verifying sampling bump.
ops-bot: Lab canary job 1769098770 ran on staging: 10k requests, sampling x10, no p95 regression observed. Results uploaded s3://redwood-tests/atten-canary/1769098770.csv :thumbsup:
Sam Kim: Example runtime client snippet:
```js
const cfg = await configClient.get('route:payments');
if (cfg.attenuation && cfg.attenuation.active) {
  telemetry.increment('attenuated_request');
  // extra debug logs for first N samples
}
```
Nora: UX nit: console graph should map attenuation factor to expected p95 change so SREs can reason about tradeoffs. Also add quick actions: pause, force-override, set sampling.
Luis: Rollback playbook: if attenuation still shows regressions after 3 iterations, auto-rollback and post to #eng-oncall with request ids + small trace sample. Add an alert payload example.
Priya Patel: Tests: unit for score calc, integration for rollout path to verify attenuation reduces exposure and raises sampling, and dashboard snapshot test.
Sam Kim: Action items: Sam update PR with contract + tests, Priya add telemetry gating checklist, Nora mock badge + console flows, Luis draft rollback notification payload. ops-bot: schedule prod-canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
ops-bot: scheduled job attn-prod-canary-2026-03-23-08:00.
ops-bot: job completed (attn-prod-canary-2026-03-23-08:00): 200k requests, minor jitter, results uploaded s3://redwood-tests/atten-prod/1769098799.json
Priya Patel: Leaving inline PR comments.
Sam Kim: Updated PR #4821 with tests and contract docs; tagging @Priya @Luis @Nora for review.
Nora: We'll add badge designs to next sprint.
Luis: Looks good to me. Low-friction way to make rollouts safer. :+1:
Sam Kim: Thanks everyone, will ping when reviewed.
